label: Original-phase input l/r/3/2/s at middle positions (t=2..6)
explanation: Fires only during the original (input) phase. It never fires at t=0, on the <DEL> step, or anywhere in the copy phase. Activity peaks at original positions 3-5 and is rare at t=1 and t>=7. It is token-selective: the input l gives the most activation mass (lift 6.5x), followed by r, 3, 2 and s. Those five tokens at t=2..6 cover about 78% of the activation mass, with precision about 0.6. Magnitude is higher when u/v/w appeared earlier in the sequence. Among l/r/3/2/s inputs, precision is 0.71 with earlier u/v/w and 0.49 without. The top examples are l right after runs like u v w. Firing is mostly on the first occurrence of a token (90% of mass). The remaining activations are weak and spread over many other letters (h, c, y, x, d...), often after u/v/w. Many l/r/3/2/s inputs without that context stay below threshold.
